5 criteria × 20 points · Show what works, what you tested and what you learned.

CRITERIONGOOD · 12 / 20EXCELLENT · 20 / 20
01  AI Fit
20 points
AI solves a defined part of the problem.Explain why AI is better than simpler options.
02  Service Design
20 points
Clear user flow, core feature and screens.Cover edge cases and low-connectivity use.
03  Prototype
20 points
A working prototype shows the core function.A stable, demo-ready prototype covers the full core flow.
04  User Testing
20 points
Test with at least 1 real user and record feedback.Test with 5 users; document a change based on feedback.

20 points
The prototype matches your BM-week business model.Refine the BM using what prototyping and testing reveal.
Scoring scaleLevel 1 → 4 pts  ·  2 → 8  ·  3 → 12  ·  4 → 16  ·  5 → 20

33
GStack · Strengthen your BM work
34 / 40

Meet your “Before We Build” coach.

Office Hours is a structured conversation that helps you decide what deserves your next build.

YOU

“Let’s add five more features!”

OFFICE HOURS

“Which customer needs them? What have you observed? Which one would help most?”

Better questions

Clarify the user, the pain, today’s alternative and the evidence.

A useful sequence

Understand the problem → choose a focused improvement → plan the work.

A way to check

Define the result you expect and how you will test it.

Think of GStack as an AI development mentor: it adds working guidance to your coding tool. You bring the business knowledge and make the decisions.

“Coach” and “mentor” are metaphors. This is software, not direct expert advice or YC certification. AI questions help you investigate; they do not prove market demand.
